verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੁ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਰਬਾਤਮ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh saadh sa(n)g sabadh surat liv pooran braham sarabaatam kai jaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: A Guru-conscious person strings the word divine in the thread of his consciousness in the company of saintly persons. He acknowledges the presence of omnipresent Lord in the form of soul in every one.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਰਿਦੈ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਬਿਹਸਿ ਮਿਲਨ ਸਮ ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: sahaj subhai ridhai bhaavanee bhagat bhai bihas milan sam dharas dhiaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: He is ever engrossed in the love and faith of the Guru Lord in his mind. He treats all alike and smilingly too.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਮ੍ਰਤਾ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸਾਨ ਮਤਿ ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: ni(n)mrataa nivaas dhaas dhaasan dhaasaan mat madhur bachan mukh benatee bakhaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: The Guru-conscious person who ever lives in the presence of the True Guru is always humble and has the intellect of being the slave of slaves (of the Guru). And when he speaks, his words are sweet and full of supplication.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗ ਆਤਮ ਅਵੇਸ ਪਰਮਾਤਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੀਐ ॥੧੩੭॥
verses.translit_en: poojaa praan giaan gur aagiaakaaree agrabhaag aatam aves paramaatam nidhaaneeaai ||137||

en.bdb: A Guru-oriented person remembers Him with every breath and stays in Lord's presence like an obedient being. Thus his soul remains absorbed in the treasure house of peace and tranquillity. (137)
